# Amplifier Module Tool Task

Task delegation tool for Amplifier that enables AI agents to spawn sub-sessions for complex subtasks.

## Tech Stack
- Python 3.11+
- Part of the Amplifier framework ecosystem

## Development
```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"
python -m pytest
```

## Structure
This is an Amplifier tool module that provides task management and tracking.

## Conventions
- Follow existing code patterns
- Include type hints
- Write docstrings for public functions
